cohort: Patients who underwent delivery at 7 Air Force Hospital, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, between January 2019 and December 2023.
finding: The overall rate of caesarean delivery increased from 21.3% in 2019 to 32.2% in 2023, with previous caesarean status identified as the most common indication.
mod_finding: The incidence of neonatal birth asphyxia decreased from 1.28% in 2019 to 0.5% in 2023, occurring concurrently with the rise in caesarean delivery rates.
